en: A sepia-toned historical photograph showing a large group of people in traditional Balkan-style clothing posing in a narrow courtyard between wooden, overhanging houses. On the right is an ornate arched structure attached to a building, decorated with Orthodox Christian icon paintings in roundels above the arch. The scene has the appearance of a village or small town street in an Ottoman-era Balkan settlement.
